opportunities.title: Small Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to researchers from all countries globally; projects can be conducted anywhere in the world. BES membership required. Not for completing undergraduate or master's degrees, not a scholarship, and not for projects forming part of a funded fellowship. Two reference statements required.
opportunities.summary: Funding up to £5,000 for new and innovative ecological research of the highest international standard, with a clear ecological science focus.

opportunities.title: Synthesis Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Main applicant must be a BES member; working groups of 8-15 individuals with diverse mix of career stages, institutions and international participation; groups not formed entirely of academic institution members.
opportunities.summary: Funding up to £30,000 over two years to bring together diverse interdisciplinary groups of 8-15 individuals for data analysis and synthesis, following FAIR principles and hybrid meeting model.

opportunities.title: Long-term Research Grants

amount.raw: up to £500 per year for a decade; £3,500 claimable in year 1 and a further £3,500 in year 6

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member; open to all types of ecologists including conservation practitioners, reserve managers, consultants and university academics; awarded to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Provides small annual funding over 10 years to extend existing short-term projects (with 1-2 years of data) into long-term ecological studies, funding a few days of data collection each year.

opportunities.title: Pedagogical Research and Development Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; no geographical restrictions; open to anyone involved in teaching ecology at any level in formal or informal settings, and those in industry exploring new teaching ideas; awarded to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Funds research informing teaching and learning practices in ecology education, providing evidence-based examples, systematic reviews, exploration of emerging education research, and dissemination of best practice.

opportunities.title: Connecting Ecologists with Other Disciplines Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to PhD students, postdoctoral fellows, early career ecologists, established researchers and employees of other organisations; must have employer/supervisor approval and a willing host organisation; undergraduates and masters students not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Funds secondments/placements (up to 12 months) immersing an ecologist in a distinctly different professional world (another discipline, NGO, public sector, business) to build interdisciplinary skills.

opportunities.title: Outreach and Engagement Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must have BES membership; open to individuals, teams and organisations across all experience levels; no restrictions on where applicants come from or carry out work; proposals must target a non-academic audience.
opportunities.summary: Supports BES members to deliver independent outreach, public engagement and science communication activities engaging public audiences with the importance and relevance of ecological science.

opportunities.title: Training and Travel Grants

amount.raw: maximum of £500 for in-person events; maximum of £250 for virtual conferences/courses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member and a PhD student or postgraduate researcher registered on a postgraduate research degree programme; work or study at a university or research institution; work in scientific areas within ecology remit; must give a presentation if attending a meeting. Postdocs, undergraduates and masters students not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Helps PhD students and postgraduate researchers meet the costs of specialist field training courses and to present their work at workshops and conferences. Awarded on a lottery-based system. Next round opens 24 August 2026.
